comment: The ten markets. Eight shares, Franklin Templeton's BENJI and gold.
Each one is a stand-in token this repository mints until DTCC's land; the
prices are real. `ltv` is the share of the collateral a position may borrow
against, `threshold` where it becomes liquidatable, both in basis points.
A loop at L times carries an LTV of (L - 1) / L, so the LTV here is also the
Amplify ceiling: 3000 bps is 1.43x, 5000 bps is 2x.
`offHoursBuffer` tightens both numbers while the share's session is shut,
which is the rule the Solana build runs: the token trades around the clock,
the company behind it does not.
`feed` is the RedStone data service feed id. BENJI is a NAV feed, not a DEX
price: a fund share has no market, it has a net asset value, and RedStone
publishes it as such. Gold is a cross, XAU/USD.
